traceability.notes:
Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION is fully implemented.
Mapping to acceptance criteria: - File-Level Annotations: `ensureFileSupportsAnnotation` is invoked for all detected test files; it reports `missingFileSupports` when no @supports is present and can auto-insert a safe placeholder template. Tests cover both presence and auto-fix behavior. - Describe Block Story References: `handleDescribeCall` enforces that describe() strings match `describePattern` (default `"Story [0-9]+\\.[0-9]+-"`), with clear error message `missingDescribeStory`. Tests include a failing case where the story phrase is missing. - Test Name Requirement Prefixes: `handleItOrTestCall` ensures `it()`/`test()` names start with `[REQ-...]` and emits `missingReqPrefix` otherwise. Tests cover missing prefixes and malformed variants with auto-fix, as well as a correct, unchanged prefix. - Quality Standards: The rule follows ESLint best practices (meta.type, fixable, schema, message IDs, helper separation) and is narrow in scope, only operating on files whose paths match simple, configurable patterns, minimizing overhead. - Integration: The rule is registered and dynamically loaded in `src/index.ts`, with severities wired into both `recommended` and `strict` configs. Tests verify this configuration. - Error Messages: meta.messages strings match the examples given in the story and are exercised in Jest tests via messageId assertions. - Framework Support: The helper recognizes `describe`, `it`, `test`, and `context` as test framework calls. Enforcement is applied to `describe`, `it`, and `test`, which cover Jest and Mocha’s primary APIs; `context` is accepted without additional constraints, ensuring compatibility rather than spurious failures. - Documentation: `user-docs/api-reference.md` contains a detailed, user-focused description of `traceability/require-test-traceability`, its behavior, options, and an example, satisfying the documentation criterion.
The rule also leverages existing global validation (valid-story-reference and valid-req-reference) to satisfy REQ-TEST-SUPPORTS-VALID once @supports annotations are present, consistent with the story’s declared dependencies. All dedicated Jest tests for this story’s rule pass, and the plugin configuration and documentation are aligned with the specification. Therefore this story is assessed as fully implemented.
